brand.notes: Sharp AC for PK market (Sharp Corporation, Japan). PK import/warranty reported by ledmart.pk as ORIENT Electronics; retail range = AH-X/AY-X J-Tech DC inverter splits (AH-X12/18/24SEV, AH-XP18MV, AY-X12/18/24HCP, AY-X12CTEP, AY-X24HCPS) + floor-standing X24C3 + conventional 24RCM. Primary sources: official Sharp Air App error-code table (83 hyphenated main-sub codes, high — remote readout) + SM-ZU1/ZHU1 service manual + TRS Engineering JP list + SHARP(CHINA) AY-X9PSR service manual (25 indoor E/P display codes + 31 outdoor LED1 blink counts — model-scoped, PSR family not confirmed sold in PK). Three code schemes kept in separate series files, digits never merged. Quarantines: TCL PS-Cloud near-twin, Sharp TV/mobile/fridge/copier codes, other-brand SERP tables, Scribd 2016 residential doc (unreadable).
